description: Source code for handling UL-DCCH messages in 5G NR RRC protocol, including message type choices, serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice type for UL-DCCH message, handling different message variants and serialization.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_type_c::c1_c_
classes.description: Represents specific message types within the c1 choice, with methods for setting, JSON conversion, packing, and unpacking.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_type_c::msg_class_ext_c_
classes.description: Represents message class extension, with nested types and methods for handling different extension variants.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_type_c::msg_class_ext_c_::c2_c_
classes.description: Represents specific extension message types, with methods for setting, JSON conversion, packing, and unpacking.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the UL-DCCH message sequence, with methods for serialization and JSON conversion.

methods.name: destroy_
methods.description: Destroys the current message choice, freeing resources.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type or extension type, initializing the corresponding data.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the message to JSON format.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from bit stream.
